inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: A caregiver that has been employed longer than 90 days did not the remaining 15 clock hours required for pre-service that was hired 9/22/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: On the playground there is a gap between the dirt and where the bottom of the concrete walkway starts that poses a tripping hazard. Additionally, there is a jagged edge on the other side of the concrete walkway that is exposed along the bottom edge. There is a cut on the metal fence that poses a hazard to the children as it can cut them.   The various ointment and suncreens were observed in the children's cubbies have been placed out of reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Removing Gloves: A caregiver was observed changing multiple diapers, while wearing gloves, and did not remove the gloves and wash hands after each diaper change.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Removing Gloves (26 TAC §746.3415(13))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was left on the playground outside by themselves. Staff did not have physical proximity to the child nor did they have auditory or visual awareness of the child's ongoing activities as they were unaware of where the child was.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles: A 5 month old was observed having the bottle propped.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Never Prop Bottles (26 TAC §746.2419(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: One staff was observed caring for 8 children with one child being 16 months of age and the remainder of the children being 18 months to 4 years of age. The maximum number of children to be supervised by one caregiver with one child that is younger than 17 months of age is 5 children that are 18 months to 4 years of age and therefore, the classroom was over by 2 children in that group.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During the inspection, two caregivers were observed caring for a total of 13 children.    One of the caregivers was caring for an infant younger than 12 months and 7 children that ranged from 18 months to 4 years of age. If the child that was under 12 months of age was moved to the nursery room, then that caregiver would be caring for 5 children with the specified age group being 0-11 months of age and that classroom would be over by one child.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Infant feeding instructions were not available for review for three infants in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: A cabinet was observed that could be opened and it had chemicals and cleaning supplies that were accessible to children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: One child file reviewed did not have any immunizations in file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: The diaper changing surface have not been sanitized appropriately after diaper changes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File: A three month old infant was observed sleeping swaddled in a play yard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver was observed doing multiple diaper changes and not washing hands after.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: One child in care did not have the emergency contact address provided by the parent for the individual listed as an emergency contact. Additionally, one child in care did not have the emergency medical authorization information section complete in file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(12))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Multiple children were observed having their diaper changed and not washing hands after.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: One caregiver was observed in direct care of 11 children with three of those children being ages 0-17 months of age; the maximum number of children to be   supervised by one caregiver was 7, therefore the caregiver was over by 4 children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: The caregivers previously cited for lack of documentation of first aid & CPR had it available at inspection for review. However, a different caregiver was observed at inspection in a classroom by themselves, supervising a group of children, and lacked First Aid & Cpr training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Steps-Label Powders, Lotions, Etc. with Name: Ointments were observed in the infant classroom that did not have the child's name on it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Steps-Label Powders, Lotions, Etc. with Name (26 TAC §746.3501(5))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The play area used by children was observed having rusted screws and metal pieces as well as a wooden piece with a rusted nail sticking out of it that posed a hazard to children playing outside.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
